messages:
emily.docs: quick heads-up — PR #4128 for the Private deployment migration guide has a sample KMS ARN in the example config that looks like a customer resource. can someone from legal/security confirm if we need to redact before merging?
pranay: marking as sensitive, thanks. i'll do a content review now but agree we shouldn't merge without signoff. can you paste the snippet here?
emily.docs: pasted below — i removed most lines but left the offending line:
```yaml
kms_key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234-ef56-7890
```
emily.docs: also FYI the docs preview is failing on the branch with a linkcheck error (relative link to /dedicated/old-config) and the CI screenshot shows the code fence rendering oddly. cc @kris-engineering for the code fence fix.
marta-legal: @emily.docs thanks — that ARN definitely looks like a real resource and we require redaction. please open a docs-redaction ticket with the original file path + the PR link. include a note on whether this was copied from a customer or generated. if it was fabricated, replace with a clearly synthetic placeholder (e.g., <REDACTED_KMS_ARN>).
alex-security: we should also run the secrets scrubber on the branch and do a pattern-based scan for account IDs / ARNs. i'll run a quick scan but we need the redaction ticket to track remediation. recommend also replacing the number sequence with 012345678901 so it's obviously fake.
kris-engineering: re: code fence — the preview parser chokes when there are mixed indentation levels in the fenced block. small fix: use triple backticks + explicitly set yaml. i pushed a one-line change to the branch that normalizes the fence. that should resolve the rendering error.
ci-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck failed — 1 broken link: /dedicated/old-config referenced from migration-guide.md: line 84. full log: https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/4128/logs/linkcheck
github: PR #4128 — emily.docs updated migration-guide.md (branch: docs/migrate-private-kms). Status: checks failing, merge blocked until reviews and status checks pass. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4128
sam-release: tag — FYI release window for Dedicated v0.9 closes tomorrow 17:00 UTC. if this needs to land before the release, we must get legal signoff today and merge before 16:30 UTC to let canary pick it up. otherwise schedule for post-release patch.
pranay: i'll hold my content approval pending legal signoff. @marta-legal — can you prioritize the redaction ticket? emily, please open it and @channel the ticket number here.
emily.docs: opened REDACT-276 in our tracker and added the diff + original line. pinged marta-legal and alex-security on the ticket. link: https://tracker.internal.redwood/REDACT-276
marta-legal: acknowledged. i'll review REDACT-276 now. if it's synthetic we can apply the placeholder and approve today. if it's customer-sourced we'll need a short incident-style disclosure and org permission; that will take longer.
alex-security: quick update — local scrub found one other suspicious ARN-like string in the examples directory. i'll attach results to REDACT-276. recommend holding merge until we confirm all examples are scrubbed.
kris-engineering: code fence and linkfix pushed, rerun preview, tagging ci-bot.
ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PR #4128. current status: linkcheck in progress.
emily.docs: thanks everyone — i'll wait for REDACT-276 closure and legal signoff. if marta gives the green and the preview passes, can we aim to merge by 16:00 UTC tomorrow to make v0.9 canary? @sam-release
sam-release: yes — if legal signs off and all checks pass we can include it in the canary. if not, we'll merge in the post-release patch.
emily.docs: noted. i'll update the PR description to say "hold for REDACT-276" until we get confirmation. will ping again once REDACT-276 is resolved. :thumbsup:
